selection: First 64 unique qualifying documents in fixed parquet/row order, restricted to predeclared test hostname hash buckets 5..9; no model scores used
filters: en, language_score >= 0.8, int_score >= 3, at least 8193 GPT-2 tokens; exclude exact normalized-text matches to retained training documents; bottom-32 5-gram sketch deduplication within this cohort
training_isolation: The hostname split rule is identical to the training data protocol, so these hostnames cannot occur in the training split
limitations: Exact cross-training deduplication and hostname isolation do not prove absence of all semantic/near-duplicate overlap across different websites; within-cohort near deduplication is approximate
scope: Coherent-document length extension; the same documents are evaluated at all three lengths, separately from the main packed test stream
